Book correction: In the second line of the solution the book prints (x + y)[x + (\omega + \omega^{2})yx + \omega^{3}y^{2}]; the first term inside the bracket should be x^{2}, not x: (x + y)[x^{2} + (\omega + \omega^{2})yx + \omega^{3}y^{2}]. The book's next line, (x + y)(x^{2} - xy + y^{2}), uses the correct x^{2}.
